defects.title: Cart shipping estimate shows Ground 0.00 but checkout charges Ground 10.00 for the same address
defects.environment: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com (public shared demo); guest; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: As a guest, add a product to the cart (the tests use Health Book, 10.00)
Under Estimate shipping, select Country "United States", enter Zip / postal code "10001" and select "Estimate shipping"
Select Checkout, continue as guest, and enter a billing address in New York 10001, United States
At Shipping Method, note the Ground price; continue to Confirm Order
defects.expected: The cart estimate shows the same Ground price that checkout charges for the same address (10.00).
defects.actual: The estimate lists Ground (0.00), Next Day Air (0.00), 2nd Day Air (0.00) and In-Store Pickup (0.00). Checkout offers Ground (10.00) and Confirm Order shows Shipping: (Ground) 10.00, Total: 27.00.
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation (not in the requirements): a shipping estimate should match the checkout charge. Confirm with the product owner whether the estimate is meant to be indicative only.
defects.reportedTo: Not reported yet (site owner / product owner)
defects.nextAction: Report to the site owner; if the behaviour changes, update the DWS-047 assertion.

defects.title: Login error message reveals whether an email address is registered (account enumeration)
defects.environment: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com (public shared demo); guest; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: Enter an email that is not registered (for example qa.unknown+<timestamp>@example.test) and any password; select "Log in"
Enter a registered email with a wrong password; select "Log in"
defects.expected: Both attempts show the same generic message (for example "Login was unsuccessful" with no hint whether the email exists).
defects.actual: Unknown email: "No customer account found". Registered email with wrong password: "The credentials provided are incorrect". An attacker can tell which emails have accounts. (Empty fields also show "No customer account found".)
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation: OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet (generic authentication error messages). Not stated in the requirements; product decision needed (Q-NB2).

evidence.label: DWS-002 known email: screenshot not linked (it shows the account email); message text in its test result

defects.reportedTo: Not reported yet (site owner / product owner)
defects.nextAction: Report as a security observation; if the messages are unified, update DWS-002 to DWS-004.

defects.title: Wishlist share URL uses http instead of https
defects.environment: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com (public shared demo); guest; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit
steps: As a guest, add a product to the wishlist (the tests use Health Book)
Read the URL after "Your wishlist URL for sharing:"
defects.expected: The share URL uses https, like the rest of the site.
defects.actual: The share URL is http://demowebshop.tricentis.com/wishlist/<guid>. Not verified whether the http link redirects to https.
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation: the site is served over https, so shared links should be too. Not stated in the requirements.
defects.reportedTo: Not reported yet (site owner / product owner)
defects.nextAction: Report to the site owner; check whether the http URL redirects to https.

defects.title: Invalid gift card code shows the coupon error message
defects.environment: https://demowebshop.tricentis.com (public shared demo); guest; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit

defects.actual: "The coupon code you entered couldn't be applied to your order" (the same text as an invalid coupon).
defects.expectedBasis: Recommendation: error text should name the field the user filled in. The exact wording is not specified.
defects.reportedTo: Not reported yet (site owner / product owner)
defects.nextAction: Report to the site owner; if a gift-card message is introduced, update the DWS-045 assertion.
